## Summary

A clear, one-sentence description of the proposed feature.

## Problem / Motivation

What problem does this solve? What use case does it enable? Why is it needed?

## Proposed Behavior

Describe the desired behavior. Include example CLI commands, YAML shapes, or API signatures if relevant.

## Alternatives Considered

What other approaches did you consider? Why is this one preferred?

## Relevant ADR or Invariant

If the feature relates to an existing architectural decision or invariant (e.g. `ADR-L-0002`, `CAP-0001`), note it here. If the feature requires a new architectural decision, indicate whether you plan to author an ADR.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Criterion 1
- [ ] Criterion 2

## Additional Context

Any other context, references, or prior art.
